note: Main-grid runs are single runs of two set-ups that also differ in L-BFGS memory and warm start (supervised: memory 20, warm start; plain: memory 1, cold start). Their step counts are not the effect of the agent alone and no speed-up is claimed from them. The like-for-like test is the step-cap sweep.
fmax_unit: Forces of the annulene runs are logged in the unit of the run log (eV per bohr value labelled eV/A). The manuscript reports eV/A = logged value x 1.8897; the force target 0.02 in the logged unit is 0.038 eV/A. Files keep the logged values; columns named fmax_eV_per_A hold the converted value.
arm_key: A3p = supervised run from the weak hand schedule; A0p = plain run from the weak hand schedule; A3 = supervised run from a random schedule; A0r = plain run from a random schedule
